_comment: Checked list of integration test files that stay Unix-only for #521. Each entry names the Unix-only mechanism that still blocks a Windows port (real signal delivery, Unix-domain sockets, PTYs, unix file metadata, or the direct native-execution trust model). Converted files are removed from this list. tools/test_unix_only_tests.py refuses any #![cfg(...unix...)] test file that is not listed here, and refuses stale entries.
applet_executable_pinning.rs: shell applets plus symlink confinement and PATH executable-bit assertions
daemon_cli.rs: UnixListener/UnixStream daemon socket plus unix process/file metadata
demo_walkthrough.rs: fake compositor is a shell script launched via sh
fs_deadlines.rs: POSIX mkfifo utility plus unix file-type assertions
ladder.rs: python3 child plus real SIGTERM delivery via libc::kill
lane_a_demo.rs: fake demo tool is a shell script with chmod executable bit
lane_b_drain_signals.rs: real SIGINT delivery to a running program
lane_o_double_interrupt_cleanup.rs: real PTY Ctrl-C with SIGINT process-group semantics
lane_o_terminal.rs: needs a Linux controlling PTY for terminal handoff
live.rs: opt-in live control plane over unix-domain sockets with python3 driver
manifest_trust.rs: symlink/permission/setuid trust assertions with shell applets
model_workflows.rs: process-group SIGTERM via python3 model workers
staged_helpers.rs: asserts unix nlink/uid/mode single-link executable contract
